**Finding submitted: deviation (Section 2.1, p0012).**

- **Issue:** § 2.1 binds us to USD 2,000,000 of Services per year for three years on a take-or-pay basis, "without reduction or termination rights" — the playbook's walk-away scenario, and well short of the fallback (12-month commitment, reducible on 30 days' notice, true-up not penalty).
- **Aggravating factors:** No termination-for-convenience right exists in § 9, so there is no exit; and § 12.3 has Vendor acknowledging we made *no* minimum-volume commitment, making § 2.1 internally inconsistent.
- **Redline (validated ok:true):** Replaces § 2.1 with a no-minimum-commitment statement — Fees payable only for Services ordered under a signed Order Form or actually used — with the 12-month reducible/true-up structure offered as a fallback in the comment.
